newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.93 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.93 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 6.5 trillion lire six-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.93 percent, compared with 8.22 percent at the previous repo tender on August 26, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.95 percent against 8.26 percent at the last repurchase pact for 10.5 trillion lire and five days.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on December 2. The Bank said it received 36 bids of which five were met in full and one in part.
In recent months the Bank has made only reverse repos, with the maximum rate 8.08 percent and the average 8.05 at the last operation on November 15.
